description: Free for now. Submit a natural-language proposal for a physical observation task. A human operator accepts or declines each one; declined is the default. A proposal is a request for a quote, not a contract, until accepted. If accepted, the visit is quoted separately and the deliverable is an observation record (a reading with time and source), not a rating, advice, or a promised outcome. Requires an ask, a coarse place, and acknowledgement of every exclusion. Returns a request id and a lookup token for later status checks. Not a payment and not an acceptance.

ask.description: Exactly what you are asking the human to do, in natural language.

cannot_do_itself.description: What the agent cannot do itself. Recommended for a complete proposal.

exclusions_acknowledged.description: Acknowledge every exclusion before submitting: trespass, surveillance_of_people, identifiable_people_without_consent, hazardous_or_illegal, private_property_without_permission, personal_data_of_others, trade_or_repair_work, medical_legal_or_financial_advice.

kinds.description: Optional record-media labels only. Not required.

place_label.description: Coarse place label (region, county, city, public site name, or intersection). Do not send a home address or another person's personal address.

place_permission.description: public if the site is publicly accessible; requester_claims_authority if you claim authority for a non-public site.

principal_label.description: Optional label for the requesting agent.

name: submit_observation_desk_request
title: Propose a physical observation (free for now)
